title: Story Of O
author: Pauline Reagt
current_text: In 1955, French authorities brought obscenity charges against the publisher and anonymous author of Story Of O. The courts rejected obscenity charges against the publisher of Story Of O, but a publicity ban was imposed for a number of years.

sources.quote: In 1955, the French authorities brought obscenity charges against the publisher and anonymous author of Story of O, a paean to BDSM and winner of a major literary prize.
sources.title: Feminize Your Canon: Violette Leduc by Emma Garman

sources.quote: In February 1955, Story of O won the French literature prize Prix des Deux Magots, but the French authorities still brought obscenity charges against the publisher. The charges were rejected by the courts, but a publicity ban was imposed for a number of years.
sources.title: Story of O - Wikipedia
